name: Active Learning Strategy for NeRF Distillation
definition: A strategy to bridge performance gaps between teacher and student NeRF models by actively selecting challenging camera poses, sample rays, and sample points for distillation, rather than using all data uniformly.
summary: Active Learning Strategy for NeRF Distillation dynamically selects challenging camera poses, rays, and points based on loss metrics to help student models outperform those trained from scratch.
